name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task's 'each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' is a conditional rule, so a hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) is the right template. The siren stays on until the agent toggles the switch, so one toggle discharges every ringing step, and the machine closes the obligation on that toggle.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, the agent turns the siren switch off: whenever the siren is ringing, a switch toggle follows on that step or later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
